Position: Software/ .Net Developer 
 Duration: 6+ months Contract to Hire 
 Role: They are requiring Senior level Software Engineer to handle the development and maintenance of applications using Microsoft and Oracle. The qualified candidate must have experience contributing to a scrum team that is building and delivery software. 
 · Plan new/modified application design based upon development requirements. 
 · Review, verify and revise understanding of requirements and planned program design with IT management, peer developers, and end-users. 
 · Relied upon for extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish tasks. 
 Experience: 
 · Advanced development experience in VB.NET , C#, JQuery, AJAX, WCF, WinForms, ASP.NET , and other Microsoft development technologies. 
 · Microsoft, Oracle, and/or Scrum Certifications are strongly preferred. 
 · Ability to develop software utilizing Scrum and other Agile techniques.
